# Quantifying the BLEU Score Difference Between the Insertion-Deletion Transformer and the Insertion-Only Baseline

## Introduction

The Insertion-Deletion Transformer is a transformer-based neural architecture and training method for sequence generation proposed by Ruis, Stern, Proskurnia, and Chan ([Ruis et al., 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.05540)). The central empirical claim of the paper is that augmenting an insertion-only generation framework with an explicit deletion phase yields measurable gains in translation quality as measured by BLEU.
